description: Check the tool definitions an agent loads, before they cost tokens or fail: estimated tokens per tool, schema errors per provider (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Bedrock, MCP; add openai_strict for strict mode) with JSON paths and fixed definitions, tool pairs models will confuse with fix hints, basic poisoning patterns, a grade and a pin (set_id) for diff_tools. Pass "tools" (array in any common format) or "url" (public remote MCP server; tools are listed, never called). level "lite" returns the summary only. Free: 20 calls/day per IP (shared with diff_tools), then $0.003 lite / $0.01 full via x402 or credits.

level.description: lite = summary only; full (default) = every issue, fixed definitions, pair hints

providers.description: Providers to check (default openai, anthropic, gemini, bedrock, mcp; add openai_strict for Structured Outputs strict mode). GET: comma list.

tools.description: Tool definitions: MCP tools/list entries, OpenAI {type:"function",function:{...}}, Anthropic {name,description,input_schema}, Gemini functionDeclarations or Bedrock toolSpec. Max 500.

url.description: Public remote MCP server URL (Streamable HTTP, https), e.g. https://api.youraitools.co/mcp/hub. ToolFit only lists its tools.

name: audit_tools
title: Audit a tool list (ToolFit)
